title: The long corridor
goals: Reach the foot of the steps.
starting_code: # Walk to the foot of the steps in one instruction.
hints: You can walk all the way to the steps with just one instruction.
Use `move_left` and give it a number.
Put the number six as the argument inside the brackets.
intro: This path goes all the way to the foot of the steps. Instead of writing six lines, let's use an argument to walk there in just one instruction!
outro: That was so much faster! Now we just have to climb these steps to get back to the gate.
learned: Now you know what an argument is, and that the move actions have one that says how far.
